name: Wellness Navigators
organisation: Ravensthorpe Community Centre (RCC) and Taleem Centre
status: Live - grant-funded project (status not stated in the pathways document)
whoFor: Economically inactive adults in Dewsbury, Ravensthorpe and nearby who face health, disability, confidence, language, digital or isolation barriers.
locations: Ravensthorpe Community Centre, 24 Garden Street, Ravensthorpe, Dewsbury, WF13 3AR
Taleem Centre, 36 Orchard Street, Savile Town, Dewsbury, WF12 9LT
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Lives in Kirklees, in a high-deprivation ward
Has a health condition - physical, mental health or learning difficulties
exclusions: People who have been in contact with employment services in the past six months
referralRoutes: Drop-in sessions, community groups, QR code and application form
Referrals from other providers and support organisations

selfReferral.note: Not at the moment, according to the pathways document

activities.name: Wellness Navigators: Pathways to a Healthy Working Life
activities.summary: Weekly wellbeing and employability workshops, fortnightly one-to-one keyworker support, peer support, bilingual guidance and practical 'Taste of Work' activities. Links people on to Employment Kirklees, REAL Employment, Kirklees Adult Learning, supported volunteering and suitable jobs.
activities.duration: Six months, with weekly provision over two to three days

workExperience: Yes - 'Taste of Work' activities and supported volunteering

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
